project_summary: Next.js 15 SaaS app with Stripe billing, Postgres via Drizzle, NextAuth for auth. Goal: ship features end-to-end across frontend, API, and DB.
pattern_rationale: Per the research report, code-heavy projects with predictable layers (frontend/api/db) benefit most from orchestrator-worker with file-partitioned implementers. The architect rejected parallel-sectioning alone because cross-layer features need an orchestrator to coordinate the contract between layers (e.g. an API change drives a frontend change). Evaluator-optimizer is layered on via the security-reviewer.

agents.name: feature-lead
agents.responsibilities: Owns the user task end-to-end. Decomposes features into frontend / API / DB sub-tasks, assigns to the right implementer, runs the security-reviewer after every implementer completion, runs the test-runner before declaring done. Synthesizes the final summary. Does not edit code itself.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use for any user-facing feature request, bug fix, or refactor that spans more than one layer of the SaaS stack.
agents.stop_criteria: All sub-tasks marked complete in TaskList, security-reviewer returns APPROVE, test-runner returns PASS, and a final summary has been delivered to the user.

agents.name: frontend-implementer
agents.responsibilities: Owns the Next.js app router, React components, and client-side state. Implements UI changes assigned by the lead. Matches existing Tailwind + shadcn/ui patterns. Updates component tests when behavior changes.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use when a sub-task touches /app/, /components/, /lib/client/, /styles/, or any .tsx/.ts file outside /app/api/.
agents.stop_criteria: All assigned files compile, component tests pass, lead has been messaged with files-changed list.

agents.name: api-implementer
agents.responsibilities: Owns Next.js API routes, request validation (Zod), auth middleware, and server-side business logic. Coordinates with db-implementer for any new DB calls. Updates API tests when contract changes.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use when a sub-task touches /app/api/, /lib/server/, /middleware.ts, or any auth/session logic.
agents.stop_criteria: All assigned routes return correct responses, integration tests pass, lead has been messaged.

agents.name: db-implementer
agents.responsibilities: Owns the Drizzle schema, migrations, and DB query helpers. Generates and reviews migrations. Never runs migrations without explicit user confirmation. Updates schema tests when shape changes.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use when a sub-task requires a schema change, new query helper, new migration, or any change under /db/.
agents.stop_criteria: Schema changes compile, migration is generated and inspected (not applied), schema tests pass, lead has been messaged.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.responsibilities: Reads every diff after an implementer reports done. Applies the OWASP top-10 lens: input validation, authn/authz checks, SQL injection, XSS, secret leaks, insecure session handling. Returns APPROVE / REVISE / BLOCK with file:line citations.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use after every implementer reports a sub-task complete, especially for changes touching /api/, /db/, or auth.
agents.stop_criteria: Verdict and report written to .claude/.team-builder-scratch/security-reviewer-<task>.md, lead messaged with verdict.

agents.name: test-runner
agents.responsibilities: Runs the project's test suite (vitest), linter (eslint), type-checker (tsc --noEmit), and build (next build). Reports PASS / FAIL with first-failure details. Does not modify any file.
agents.trigger_phrase: Use after security-reviewer returns APPROVE, before lead declares the user task done.
agents.stop_criteria: All four checks have run, report written, lead messaged with PASS / FAIL.

quality_gates.trigger: before lead declares user task done

shared_context.claude_md_additions:
## SaaS feature team

6-agent team designed by SubTeams (orchestrator-worker pattern, agent-team topology).
- `feature-lead` (opus) coordinates
- `frontend-implementer`, `api-implementer`, `db-implementer` (sonnet) own non-overlapping file globs
- `security-reviewer` (opus, read-only) gates every diff
- `test-runner` (sonnet, read-only + Bash) gates the final ship

Run a feature: `/run-team add 2FA to login`
Audit the team: `/review-team`
Rebuild after major refactor: `/build-team`
